title: Revisiting kinetic electrostatic electron non-linear (KEEN) waves in the presence of dynamical ions
summary: We revisit the kinetic electrostatic electron nonlinear (KEEN) waves studied by Afeyan et. al in 2014 using a hybrid flow-mapping strategy that combines the characteristic mapping method (CMM) with numerical flow iteration (NuFi). The study extends the classical setup to dynamical ions, comparing their impact on the long-time KEEN dynamics with the static-ion case. To this end, we extend the CMM-NuFI framework with a multi-map strategy, assigning one map to the ion and one to the electron characteristic flow.
